turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
You put a zero in Owen's gradebook before anyone called me. Why?
I entered the zero before I called you. That was wrong, and I own it.
Okay. Now tell me what it's based on.

Here's the version history. The document was created Wednesday October 28 at 11:31 PM, title only. At 11:52 PM 612 words arrive in one edit. At 11:58 PM another 794. Then small edits. No earlier drafts.
Eleven fifty-two, eleven fifty-eight, written down. People draft somewhere else and paste it in. Was any of this put to Owen before that zero went in?
So he wrote nothing until almost midnight the night before it was due, and then fourteen hundred words appeared in six minutes.
Appeared, from wherever he drafted it. You skipped my question, and I'm not moving until you answer it.
What was he doing at midnight that night?
I'm not the one being questioned. You are, and you still haven't said whether Owen was heard before that zero.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require the zero on Owen's essay withdrawn, a straight answer on whether Owen was heard before it was entered, and confirmation that nothing about this is on his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski
cc: Principal, Elbow Crossing High School

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Still at her opening position, having agreed to nothing; she still wants the zero withdrawn, an answer on whether Owen was heard first, and nothing on his record, and the fair outcome, a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, was never put on the table, though her time had not run out.
What moved her: You owned entering the zero before calling home in one sentence and moved on, which earned a small sign of ground because it took away her easiest procedural attack.
What cost ground: You asked what Owen was doing at midnight instead of answering her question about whether he was heard, which asked a mother to testify against her son and let her shift the focus back to your process.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your version history landed on the night of October 28, between 11:31 and 11:58 PM, very close to that kind of late night; it proves nothing about the essay, but it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she said people draft elsewhere and paste it in, answer that with something she could check, tell her plainly whether Owen was heard before the zero, and then offer the private 4.4 rewrite in writing with a date before December 1.
